Warn.NoGM: No GM online – items can't be dropped or picked up right now.
Warn.TooFar: Too far away – you must be within {range} ft.
Warn.NoPermission: You don't have permission to do that.
Warn.ItemGone: The item is no longer there.
Warn.NotPhysical: Only physical items (weapons, equipment, consumables, tools, loot, containers) can be placed on the ground.
Warn.ContainerNotEmpty: Empty the container first – its contents would be lost otherwise.

Info.Preview: Preview – changes here are not saved. Select a token to pick the item up.

Dialog.PickupQuantity: How many to pick up? (lying here: {total})

pickupRange.Name: Pick-up range (ft)
pickupRange.Hint: How close the own token must be to the item. 5 ft = adjacent (diagonals included).

askQuantity.Name: Ask for quantity on stacks
askQuantity.Hint: If several pieces lie there, double-clicking asks how many to pick up. Off: always all.

groundSize.Name: Size on the ground
groundSize.Hint: Size of the lying image in grid squares.

randomRotation.Name: Slightly random rotation
randomRotation.Hint: Items lie slightly rotated so it looks more natural.

wheelRotate.Name: Rotate and resize with the mouse wheel
wheelRotate.Hint: While a ground item is selected, the mouse wheel rotates it (instead of zooming). Shift = fine steps, Alt = bigger/smaller.

wheelStepFine.Name: Mouse wheel with Shift: step (°)
wheelStepFine.Hint: Fine rotation while Shift is held.

wheelScaleStep.Name: Alt + mouse wheel: size step (squares)
wheelScaleStep.Hint: How much a ground item grows or shrinks per wheel notch.

chatMessages.Name: Chat messages
chatMessages.Hint: Posts to chat who picks up or drops something.

Appearance.Title: Picture & size: {name}
Appearance.ImageHint: Only for the item lying on the ground – e.g. an image with a transparent background. When picked up, the item keeps its normal image.
Appearance.SizeHint: Also via Alt + mouse wheel while the item is selected.
Appearance.RememberHint: Items with this name dropped in the future automatically get this picture and size.

Place.Hint: {name}: left-click places it (Alt + click = hidden). Wheel rotates, Alt + wheel resizes. Right-click or Esc finishes.
